ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access lets you record words for your parrot and capture sounds during training.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Use a photo you choose as your parrot's profile picture.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Use the camera to take a profile photo of your parrot.
